checks.sources: All fourteen exact cache files independently matched immutable Hub SHA256/size or Git blob ID at the historical revision. They remain identical at published revision 718e0edd, independently verifying the supplied current-input check. No model/API grading was used.
checks.parser: ASTs of every extracted grading definition and assignment match the original Git object in order, including both assignments of _BOXED_RE. The later historical regex override is retained; no modernized grading behavior was substituted. A separately written scalar extractor reproduced all saved per-row letters and correctness.
checks.row_and_question_identity: Verified unique qid/seed/row_id and stage for every observed draw, identical question prompt bytes and gold across seeds/models, exact historical retrieval eligibility row-ID sets, and historical aggregate correct/unparseable/rollout counts. All 198 planned questions have positive observed counts in both models; missing draws remain explicit.
checks.estimands: Independently reconstructed count/correct arrays. Pooled accuracy uses each model's observed rollout denominator; equal-question accuracy averages per-question observed means. The complete sensitivity uses exactly the same 194 five-draw questions in both models. Worst/best bounds use all 990 planned draws per model; difference bounds combine opposite endpoints.
checks.bootstrap: Regenerated the exact RNG sequence (2000, seed20260912), verified saved indices and complete-subset indices, and recomputed every sample for all three estimands with scalar arithmetic. The same question multiplicities apply to both models. Paired-difference samples are model differences within each draw; all percentile endpoints independently recomputed using sorted linear interpolation.
checks.publication: All ten completed artifacts matched their receipt and immutable Hub metadata. Marker binds the exact report and all nine other files; copied reader/plan match the reviewed source and declared plan.

cases: Actual reader rejects relabeling two same-gold comparison questions across all seeds, while preserving the complete retrieval row-ID set and making the substituted bytes consistent with the mocked metadata; rejection occurs before bootstrap.
Actual reader rejects changed input bytes at the metadata boundary and leaves no completion marker.
Actual reader refuses to overwrite a completed artifact directory.
Actual batched helper and difference intervals match a scalar oracle with unequal cluster counts; deliberately unpaired model draws produce different intervals.

reporting_limitations: The aggregate accuracies were already known and the two models were selected before this clarification. This is exploratory uncertainty for a fixed selection, not prospective confirmation or selection-adjusted inference.

Question-cluster percentile intervals condition on these recorded seed outcomes and treat benchmark questions as exchangeable. They do not measure benchmark representativeness, cross-model selection uncertainty, or separately resample generation seeds.

The pooled estimate weights observed draws; equal-question and complete-question analyses address different weighting/eligibility sensitivities. Neither proves missing draws are ignorable. Missing-draw bounds are deterministic worst/best sensitivity bounds, not confidence intervals.

Grading reproduces the pinned historical deterministic parser, including its late boxed-regex override and unparseable-as-incorrect rule. The audit does not establish that this parser is an ideal semantic answer grader.
These GPQA results do not establish global capability, a causal capability effect, or any main representation-predictability outcome.
